items.text: ETR weekend summary: NOT EXPECTED - McConkey, Caleb Williams, Dowdle, MHJ, Slayton, Palmer. GTD - Jefferson/Addison, Jeanty, McLaurin, DJ Moore. EXPECTED - Flowers, Tate, Stevenson, Kamara, Keenan Allen. No Bengals WR word yet; messiest week.
items.implication: Core Sunday monitor list; projections docked for injury risks.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries already noted per player; Bengals WRs still fluid (Chase/Higgins Q).

items.text: Vikings WRs Justin Jefferson (ankle) and Jordan Addison (hamstring) both Q; will work out pregame. Jefferson determined for Louisiana homecoming.
items.implication: High-stakes monitor; both in or one out swings MIN WR hierarchy and Kamara matchup.
items.opportunity: If either out, remaining WR + TE volume up.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (foot), who didn’t practice, is not expected to play vs Broncos.
items.why: Did not practice all week with foot injury.
items.implication: Sit in all formats; opens targets for other LAC WRs behind Herbert's struggling OL (4 rookies starting).
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Quentin Johnston and others.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty (plantar fasciitis/ankle) hopeful to play but GTD; will work out pregame. Team elevated RB in case.
items.why: Missed late-week practice; flare-up. Hopeful but not definite.
items.implication: Monitor warmups closely; if out, handcuff elevated RB becomes priority.
items.opportunity: If active, full workload; if out, backup volume spike.

items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; he will be inactive vs DET as details completed. Texans primary team to watch.
items.why: Trade being finalized; team informed him inactive this morning.
items.implication: Zero fantasy production; permanent role change post-trade. Michael Wilson and others elevated in ARI WR room short-term.
items.opportunity: Full targets/snaps to remaining ARI WRs (Wilson primary).

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels making return from elbow injury (brace); active vs Giants.
items.why: Return after two games missed; non-throwing elbow, brace on.
items.implication: Start with some risk (doctors note reinjury concern per Schefter); limited weapons (Diggs out, McLaurin Q).
items.conflict: Schefter: doctors believe when-not-if further elbow injury.

items.text: Chargers starting 4 rookies on OL (LT/LG/C/RT) vs DEN with Slater/Alt out; Herbert 6 straight games without more TDs than INTs.
items.implication: Major pressure risk for Herbert and remaining pass catchers (McConkey already out).
items.opportunity: Negative for all LAC skill; possible short/checkdown increase.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (foot, Q) is expected to play vs Falcons SNF.
items.why: Sources confirm expected despite foot injury listing.
items.implication: Start with confidence; primary WR with Lamar out (Huntley starting).

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (back) expected to play vs Vikings.
items.implication: Start as usual; no major dock.

items.text: Patriots RB Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) expected to play.
items.implication: Lock in as RB1; TreVeyon Henderson handcuff only.

items.text: Steelers RB Rico Dowdle (toe, Q) unlikely to play vs Colts; final determination in warmups.
items.implication: Jaylen Warren elevated to lead back role.
items.opportunity: Full carries/snaps for Warren if Dowdle inactive.

items.text: MHJ had only 5 catches in 4 games and was never a real factor in Michael Wilson usage. Post-inactive/trade it is now Kia Kendrick Bourne / Wilson season.
items.why: Low prior production from MHJ; Wilson already earning independent role.
items.implication: Wilson clear WR1 in ARI short-term and potentially longer; Bourne also rises.
items.opportunity: Wilson snap/route/target share expands further without MHJ.

items.text: Loves Michael Wilson as WR10 vs DET, amplified by MHJ inactive/trade.
items.why: Volume already strong; MHJ absence cements alpha role vs DET secondary.
items.implication: Must-start WR; cruel for MHJ owners but Wilson boom.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown as RB5 @ MIA: gobbles targets, strong usage/matchup (Brown Gobbler).
items.why: Target/fantasy point hog; MIA matchup favorable; Bengals WR injuries could funnel more.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins as WR8 vs TEN: volume/red-zone hog in great matchup.
items.why: Target volume including RZ; TEN struggles vs WRs.

items.text: Hates Jordan Addison (WR41) @ NO: tough matchup, thin role, injury wrinkle.
items.implication: Fade even if active; prefer other options.
items.conflict: GTD status could make him zero.

items.text: Hates Cam Skattebo (RB20) @ WSH: efficiency and game environment concerns. Rapoport notes expect LOT of volume though.
items.opportunity: Rap Sheet: expect heavy Skattebo volume vs WAS.
items.conflict: Volume expectation from Rapoport conflicts with Berry efficiency fade.

items.text: Hates Jalen Hurts (QB15) vs JAX London: rough stretch, banged-up line/weapons (Barkley/Smith out).
items.why: Recent form + OL/WR injuries (Barkley, Smith, Brown out; Goedert active).
items.implication: Downgrade/sit if better options; Goedert becomes top target.
